title: Search results taking 8-12 seconds for large document sets
description: Elasticsearch queries on indices with >10M documents consistently return results in 8-12 seconds at p99. Root cause traced to suboptimal shard allocation and missing field data cache configuration for large indices. Dedicated node pool migration in progress.

title: Document upload failing intermittently for files >50MB
description: Multipart upload to S3 fails intermittently for files between 50MB and 200MB. Error: 'Upload timeout after 30s'. Occurs roughly 15% of the time on enterprise-tier uploads. S3 presigned URL generation appears to have an inconsistent timeout configuration.

title: Search total_count incorrect when using date range filters
description: The total_count field in search API responses was incorrect (off by up to 12%) when date range filters were applied. Root cause: count query did not apply the same post-filter as the results query. Fixed by aligning count and results queries.

title: Semantic search ranking inconsistent for short queries
description: Short queries (1-2 words) produced inconsistent ranking in hybrid BM25+vector mode. Vector similarity was over-weighted for short queries with low specificity. Fixed by introducing query-length-based weight adjustment.

title: Insufficient rate limiting on password reset endpoint
description: Password reset endpoint allows unlimited attempts without rate limiting. Identified in October 2025 pentest. Allows brute-force email enumeration. Fix: implement per-IP and per-email rate limiting (10 attempts/hour).

title: Missing audit log for bulk document delete operations
description: Bulk document deletion via DELETE /v2/documents/bulk does not write to the Audit Service. Individual deletions are logged correctly. Required for SOC 2 compliance (CC6.3). Fix: add Audit Service call in bulk delete handler.

title: Incomplete automated certificate rotation for internal services
description: 3 internal service certificates (workflow-service.novatech.internal; integration-service.novatech.internal; admin-service.novatech.internal) were not covered by cert-manager auto-rotation. Manual rotation required. Fixed by adding cert-manager Certificate resources for all services.

title: Webhook delivery retry not honoring 429 response
description: Webhook retry logic was treating 429 (Too Many Requests) from customer endpoints as a permanent failure and stopping retries after first 429. Should retry with backoff per spec. Fixed in January 2026 release.

title: XSS vulnerability in document title rendering (admin UI)
description: Snyk SAST scan identified stored XSS vulnerability in document title field rendering in admin UI. Document titles were rendered without HTML entity encoding. Fixed by adding DOMPurify sanitization. Patched in hotfix release March 8 2026.

title: SQL injection risk in analytics date filter
description: Snyk identified potential SQL injection in analytics endpoint date filter parameter. Parameter was passed directly to raw SQL query without parameterization. Fixed by converting to SQLAlchemy parameterized query.

title: Auth token expiry incorrect during DST transitions
description: JWT token expiry was calculated using server local time (US/Pacific) rather than UTC, causing 1-hour expiry discrepancy during daylight saving time transitions (March 8 2026). Tokens expired 1 hour early for US Pacific timezone users.

title: User SCIM sync fails when group name contains apostrophe
description: SCIM 2.0 group sync fails with 500 error when group display name contains an apostrophe (e.g., "IT Department's Users"). SQL query not properly escaped. Fixed by using parameterized queries in SCIM group handler.

title: Mobile app search results page fails to paginate on iOS 17.3
description: Search results on mobile app (iOS 17.3+) fail to load additional pages when scrolling. The 'load more' button returns a blank state. Appears to be a React Native compatibility issue with iOS 17.3 scroll event changes. Investigation ongoing.

title: Invoice PDF generation fails for accounts with >500 users
description: Invoice PDF generation times out for Enterprise accounts with >500 licensed users. PDF renderer was synchronously fetching all user records. Fixed by implementing paginated fetching and async PDF generation with email delivery.

title: Elasticsearch index alias update causes 30-second downtime
description: Monthly index rotation (alias update from previous month to new month) caused 30-second search unavailability due to alias swap not being atomic. Fixed by using Elasticsearch aliases update API with atomic add/remove.

title: Notification emails not delivered to @acme-corp.com addresses
description: Notification emails to acme-corp.com domain were being rejected by ACME's email gateway due to incorrect SPF record. NovaTech's SendGrid sending IP range was not included in the SPF record. Fixed by updating DNS SPF record and coordinating with ACME IT.

title: Analytics dashboard shows wrong user count for sub-accounts
description: For customers with organizational hierarchy (parent + sub-accounts), analytics dashboard shows only the sub-account user count when a parent admin views the dashboard. Should show aggregate count. Data query missing UNION across tenant hierarchy.

title: Document search returns deleted documents intermittently
description: After document deletion, the document occasionally appears in search results for up to 15 minutes. Root cause: Elasticsearch index update after deletion is processed asynchronously via Kafka; consumer lag causes delay. Short-term fix: increase Kafka consumer priority for delete events. Long-term: add tombstone documents.

title: SSO login fails for Azure AD tenants with MFA enforced
description: SAML SSO login flow fails for customers using Azure AD with MFA enforced when the MFA challenge takes >30 seconds to complete. SAML assertion timeout was set to 30 seconds. Fixed by increasing assertion validity window to 300 seconds.

title: Bulk document import job fails silently after 1000 documents
description: Bulk import jobs importing >1000 documents silently stop processing after document 1000 with no error. Root cause: SQS message batch limit not handled correctly in processor loop. Fixed by implementing proper SQS pagination in bulk processor.

title: Search export generates corrupted CSV for documents with embedded commas
description: Search export to CSV does not properly escape fields containing commas. Results in malformed CSV where rows are split incorrectly. Fields should be quoted per RFC 4180.

title: User profile photos not loading for SSO-provisioned users
description: Profile photos for users provisioned via SCIM/SSO were not loading. SCIM provisioner sends photo as base64 but the system expected a URL. Fixed by adding base64 photo handling in SCIM user handler.

title: Kafka consumer lag spikes during peak hours (9-10 AM PT)
description: Document processing Kafka consumer group shows 50k+ message lag during 9-10 AM PT peak. Causes notification delays of up to 8 minutes. Root cause: consumer group has insufficient partitions for peak throughput. Increasing partition count from 12 to 24.

title: Password complexity validation not enforced on API key creation
description: API key creation endpoint does not enforce minimum entropy requirements. Users can create API keys with predictable patterns. Fix: add entropy validation to API key generation with rejection of low-entropy keys.

title: Workflow service DAG execution ignores timeout on long-running steps
description: Workflow steps configured with explicit timeouts were not being cancelled when the timeout elapsed. The Celery task was correctly configured but the DAG execution engine was not propagating the revoke signal. Fixed.

title: Admin user cannot deactivate their own account
description: An admin user attempting to deactivate their own account receives a misleading error: 'User not found' instead of 'Cannot deactivate your own account'. UI should display a helpful error message and prevent the action clearly.

title: Integration with Slack sends duplicate notifications on retry
description: Slack integration was sending duplicate notifications when the Slack API returned a 503 and the integration service retried. Fix: implemented idempotency key (using notification_id) in Slack API calls to prevent duplicates on retry.

title: AI summarization returns empty response for scanned PDFs
description: Scanned PDF documents (no embedded text layer) return an empty string from the AI summarization endpoint. Root cause: document processing pipeline does not run OCR on scanned PDFs before passing content to AI service. Fix: integrate Tesseract OCR in document processing pipeline for PDF files without text layer.

title: Analytics API rate limit too low for scheduled report generation
description: Enterprise customers running scheduled nightly reports via Analytics API were hitting rate limits. The 5000 req/min Enterprise limit was shared across all API endpoints. Fix: analytics export endpoints now have a separate rate limit pool (200 req/min dedicated).

title: Search filter by tag returns 500 error when tag contains special characters
description: Searching with a tag filter where the tag contains characters like brackets or percent signs causes a 500 Internal Server Error. Query is not properly URL-decoding and sanitizing tag filter values before passing to Elasticsearch.
